# ED vs 6M ANALYSES 
```{r}
run_within_class_EDvsM6_tests <- function(data_long,
                                         metadata,
                                         apns_ordered,
                                         feature_cols,
                                         feature_name = "Feature",
                                         recovered_class_for,
                                         chronic_class_for,
                                         timepoints = c("ED", "M6"),
                                         fdr_method = "fdr",
                                         ci_digits = 3,
                                         format_for_export = FALSE,
                                         format_num_fun = format_num) {

  # helper: run one APNS×Class
  run_one <- function(apns, class_label, group_label) {

    df <- data_long %>%
      left_join(metadata, by = c("PID", "Timepoint")) %>%
      filter(Timepoint %in% timepoints) %>%
      filter(.data[[apns]] == class_label)

    pairs <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, all_of(feature_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(feature_cols),
                   names_to = feature_name,
                   values_to = "Value") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        id_cols = c(PID, !!rlang::sym(feature_name)),
        names_from = Timepoint,
        values_from = Value
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[timepoints[1]]]) & !is.na(.data[[timepoints[2]]])) %>%
      mutate(
        ED = as.numeric(.data[[timepoints[1]]]),
        M6 = as.numeric(.data[[timepoints[2]]]),
        Change = M6 - ED
      )

    # paired t-test on Change vs 0
    out <- pairs %>%
      group_by(.data[[feature_name]]) %>%
      summarise(
        TotalPairs = n(),
        Mean_ED = mean(ED, na.rm = TRUE),
        Mean_M6 = mean(M6, na.rm = TRUE),
        MeanChange = mean(Change, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = sd(Change, na.rm = TRUE),
        SE = SD / sqrt(TotalPairs),
        test = list(stats::t.test(Change, mu = 0)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ unname(.x$p.value)),
        t_stat  = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ unname(.x$statistic)),
        CI_lower = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ .x$conf.int[1]),
        CI_upper = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ .x$conf.int[2]),

        Direction = case_when(
          MeanChange > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
          MeanChange < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
          TRUE ~ "No Change"
        ),

        `Confidence Interval` = paste0(
          "[",
          formatC(CI_lower, format = "f", digits = ci_digits),
          ", ",
          formatC(CI_upper, format = "f", digits = ci_digits),
          "]"
        ),

        APNS = apns,
        Class = class_label,
        Group = group_label
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-test)

    out
  }

  # run across APNS for Recovered + Chronic
  results <- purrr::map_dfr(apns_ordered, function(apns) {

    rec <- run_one(apns, recovered_class_for(apns), "Recovered")
    chr <- run_one(apns, chronic_class_for(apns), "Chronic")

    bind_rows(rec, chr)
  })

  # FDR correction within APNS × Group strata
  results <- results %>%
    group_by(APNS, Group) %>%
    mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = fdr_method)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(APNS, Group, FDR, p_value)

  # export-friendly table (labels concise, no underscores)
  export_tbl <- results %>%
    transmute(
      Group,
      !!feature_name := .data[[feature_name]],
      `Avg Δ (6M − ED)` = MeanChange,
      `Direction over time` = Direction,
      `P value` = p_value,
      `FDR` = FDR,
      `T stat` = t_stat,
      `Confidence interval` = `Confidence Interval`,
      `Avg ED` = Mean_ED,
      `Avg 6M` = Mean_M6,
      `SD of Δ` = SD,
      `SE of Δ` = SE,
      `Total pairs` = TotalPairs, 
      APNS,
      Class
    ) %>%
    mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = apns_ordered), 
           Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Recovered", "Chronic"))) %>%
    arrange(APNS, Group, FDR, `P value`)

  if (isTRUE(format_for_export)) {
    export_tbl <- export_tbl %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), format_num_fun))
  }

  list(
    ttest_results = results,
    export_table = export_tbl
  )
}

```

## CYTOKINES
```{r}
cytokine_data <- cytokine_data %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) 

cytokines <- c("IFN_gama", "IL_10", "IL_6", "IL_8", "TNF_alpha")

cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6 <- run_within_class_EDvsM6_tests(
  data_long = cytokine_data,
  metadata = metadata_RNA_paired,
  apns_ordered = APNS_ordered,
  feature_cols = cytokines,
  feature_name = "Cytokine",
  recovered_class_for = recovered_class_for,
  chronic_class_for = chronic_class_for,
  format_for_export = TRUE)

cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export  <- cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6$export_table %>%
  dplyr::select(APNS, Group, Class, Cytokine, `Avg Δ (6M − ED)`,`T stat` , `SE of Δ`, `Confidence interval`, `P value`, FDR,`Direction over time`, `Avg ED`, `Avg 6M`  )

cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export <- cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `Recovery Group` = Group,
    `Cytokine` = Cytokine,
    `Direction Over Time`  = `Direction over time`,
    `Avg Δ (6M − ED)` = `Avg Δ (6M − ED)`,
    `P Value` = `P value`,
    `FDR` = FDR,
    `T Stat` = `T stat`,
    `Avg ED` = `Avg ED`,
    `Avg 6M` = `Avg 6M`,
    `95% CI` = `Confidence interval`,
    `SE of Δ` = `SE of Δ`,
    `APNS` = APNS,
    `Class` = Class)

write.csv(cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export, "Cytokines Analysis/ED vs 6M/Summaries/Combined_Cytokines_Analysis.csv")

```

### Export
```{r}

cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  dplyr::group_split(APNS, `Recovery Group`, .keep = TRUE) %>%
  purrr::walk(function(df) {

    apns_name <- unique(df$APNS)
    grp_name  <- unique(df$`Recovery Group`)

    out_path <- file.path(
      "Cytokines Analysis/ED vs 6M/Results per APNS",
      paste0("Cytokines_ED_vs_6M_", apns_name, "_", grp_name, ".csv")
    )

    df %>%
      dplyr::arrange(`P Value`) %>%   
      readr::write_excel_csv(out_path)
  })



wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")

make_sheet_name <- function(apns, grp, existing) {
  grp_code <- case_when(
    grp == "Recovered" ~ "R",
    grp == "Chronic"   ~ "C",
    TRUE ~ as.character(grp)
  )

  nm <- substr(paste0(apns, " - ", grp_code), 1, 31)

  if (nm %in% existing) {
    i <- 2
    repeat {
      nm2 <- substr(paste0(nm, "_", i), 1, 31)
      if (!(nm2 %in% existing)) return(nm2)
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  nm
}

existing_sheets <- character(0)

for (apns in levels(cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export$APNS)) {

  for (grp in levels(cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export$`Recovery Group`)) {

    df_sub <- cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
      filter(APNS == apns, `Recovery Group` == grp) %>%
      arrange(as.numeric(`FDR`), as.numeric(`P Value`)) 

    if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) next

    sheet_name <- make_sheet_name(apns, grp, existing_sheets)
    existing_sheets <- c(existing_sheets, sheet_name)

    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df_sub)

    addStyle(wb, sheet_name, header_style,
             rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE)

    if (nrow(df_sub) > 0) {
      addStyle(wb, sheet_name, body_style,
               rows = 2:(nrow(df_sub) + 1),
               cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE)
    }

    setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), widths = "auto")
  }
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "Cytokines Analysis/ED vs 6M/Summaries/All_APNS_Cytokines_ED_vs_6M.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

```

### Summary 
```{r}

cytokines <- cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  mutate(`P Value` = as.numeric(`P Value`)) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  summarise(
    min_p = min(`P Value`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(min_p) %>%
  pull(Cytokine)

apns_string <- function(apns) {
  if (length(apns) == 0) return("")
  paste0(apns, collapse = "; ")
}

table_cytokines_apns_summary <- cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  mutate(across(c(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, `P Value`, `FDR`, `T Stat`,
                  `Avg ED`, `Avg 6M`, `SE of Δ`), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(is_sig = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.01) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine, `Recovery Group`) %>%
  summarise(
    `APNS Avg Δ (6M − ED)` = mean(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS SE` = sd(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`))),
    `APNS Avg P Value` = mean(`P Value`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg FDR` = mean(`FDR`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg T Stat` = mean(`T Stat`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg ED` = mean(`Avg ED`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg 6M` = mean(`Avg 6M`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg SE of Δ` = mean(`SE of Δ`, na.rm = TRUE),

    `Count of Significant APNS Tests` = sum(is_sig, na.rm = TRUE),

    `Significant APNS (ED vs 6M T-tests, FDR < 0.01)` = {
      apns_sig <- APNS[is_sig]
      apns_string(apns_sig)},
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Cytokine = factor(Cytokine, levels = cytokines)) %>%
  arrange(Cytokine) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x)))


# export  ----------------------------------------------

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "APNS Summary")

writeData(
  wb,
  sheet = "APNS Summary",
  x = table_cytokines_apns_summary,
  withFilter = FALSE
)

# styling
header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")

addStyle(wb, "APNS Summary", header_style,
         rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(table_cytokines_apns_summary), gridExpand = TRUE)

addStyle(wb, "APNS Summary", body_style,
         rows = 2:(nrow(table_cytokines_apns_summary) + 1),
         cols = 1:ncol(table_cytokines_apns_summary), gridExpand = TRUE)

setColWidths(wb, "APNS Summary", cols = 1:ncol(table_cytokines_apns_summary), widths = "auto")

saveWorkbook(wb, "Cytokines Analysis/ED vs 6M/Summaries/Cytokine_APNS_Summary_ED_vs_6M.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

### Heatmap 
```{r}
hm_il6_recovered <- cytokines_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  filter(`Recovery Group` == "Recovered", Cytokine == "IL_6") %>%
  mutate(FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
         delta = as.numeric(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`),
         APNS = factor(APNS, levels = rev(APNS_ordered)),
         y_pos = "Interleukin 6",
         neglogFDR = if_else(!is.na(FDR) & FDR > 0, -log10(FDR), NA_real_),
         neglogFDR_cap = pmin(neglogFDR, 10)) %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = rev(APNS_ordered), labels = rev(APNS_labels)))

range(hm_il6_recovered$`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`)

IL6_heatmap <- ggplot(hm_il6_recovered, aes(x = y_pos, y = APNS)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = neglogFDR_cap, fill = delta),
             shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) +
  
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5, guide = "none") +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Δ IL6\n(ED \u2192 6M)",
    low = "#006A98", high = "white",
    limits = c(-0.8, 0.1), breaks = c(-0.8, -0.4, 0),
    labels = c("-0.8", "-0.4", "0"), na.value = "white") +
  
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", 
                               title.hjust = 0.5,
                               barheight = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                               barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),
                               title.theme = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(b = 8)))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL, title = NULL) + 
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(b = 0)),
    axis.ticks.x.top = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.just = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7), 
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.75)) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = expansion(mult = c(.03, .03))) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(.07, .07)))


ggsave(filename = "Cytokines Analysis/ED vs 6M/Plots/Recovered IL-6 ED vs 6M Heatmap.jpg",plot = IL6_heatmap,height = 4, width = 3, dpi = 300)
```

### Heatmap 
```{r}

cells_to_plot <- c( "Neutrophils", "CD8+ T cells", "Regulatory T cells", "Activated NK cells", 
                    "Resting NK cells", "Monocytes", "Naive B cells")


prep_cell_heatmap_export <- function(df, recovery_group = "Recovered") {
  df %>%
    filter(`Recovery Group` == recovery_group,
           `Cell Type` %in% cells_to_plot) %>%
    mutate(
      `Avg Δ (6M − ED)` = as.numeric(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR),

      APNS = factor(APNS, levels = rev(levels(APNS))),
      `Cell Type` = factor(`Cell Type`, levels = cells_to_plot),

      neglogFDR = if_else(!is.na(FDR) & FDR > 0, -log10(FDR), NA_real_),

      # only significant gets a value, and it is capped
      neglogFDR_plot = if_else(!is.na(FDR) & FDR <= 0.01,
                               pmin(neglogFDR, 10),
                               NA_real_)
    )
}

cell_hm_recovered <- prep_cell_heatmap_export(cells_within_class_EDvsM6_export, "Recovered") 

range(cell_hm_recovered$`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, na.rm = TRUE)

cell_heatmap <- ggplot(cell_hm_recovered, aes(x = `Cell Type`, y = APNS)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = neglogFDR_plot, fill = `Avg Δ (6M − ED)`),
             shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) +
  
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5, limits = c(2,10), guide = "none") +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "Δ Cell Fraction\n(ED \u2192 6M)",
    low = "#006A98", mid = "white", high = "#67B6B2", midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-0.12, 0.12), breaks = c(-0.1, 0, 0.1), na.value = "white") +
  
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                             barheight = unit(1.5, "cm"), barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),
                             title.theme = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(b = 8)))) +
  labs(x = "Estimate Cell Fractions", y = NULL, title = NULL) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.75),

    axis.text.x.top = element_text(color = "black", size = 7, angle = 35, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 0)),
    axis.ticks.x.top = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 7),
    axis.title = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.just = "center",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 7), 
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0), 
    plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(.07, .07))) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = expansion(mult = c(.075, .075)))

ggsave(cell_heatmap, filename = "Cell Fraction Analysis/ED vs 6M/Plots/Recovered ED vs 6M Cell Proportion Change Heatmap.jpg", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

### Export
```{r}

TF_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  dplyr::group_split(APNS, `Recovery Group`, .keep = TRUE) %>%
  purrr::walk(function(df) {

    apns_name <- unique(df$APNS)
    grp_name  <- unique(df$`Recovery Group`)

    out_path <- file.path(
      "Transcription Factor Analysis/ED vs 6M/Results per APNS",
      paste0("TFs_ED_vs_6M_global", apns_name, "_", grp_name, ".csv")
    )

    df %>%
      dplyr::arrange(`P Value`) %>%   
      readr::write_excel_csv(out_path)
  })



wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")

make_sheet_name <- function(apns, grp, existing) {
  grp_code <- case_when(
    grp == "Recovered" ~ "R",
    grp == "Chronic"   ~ "C",
    TRUE ~ as.character(grp)
  )

  nm <- substr(paste0(apns, " - ", grp_code), 1, 31)

  if (nm %in% existing) {
    i <- 2
    repeat {
      nm2 <- substr(paste0(nm, "_", i), 1, 31)
      if (!(nm2 %in% existing)) return(nm2)
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  nm
}

existing_sheets <- character(0)

for (apns in APNS_ordered) {

  for (grp in levels(TF_within_class_EDvsM6_export$`Recovery Group`)) {

    df_sub <- TF_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
      filter(APNS == apns, `Recovery Group` == grp) %>%
      arrange(as.numeric(`FDR`), as.numeric(`P Value`)) 

    if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) next

    sheet_name <- make_sheet_name(apns, grp, existing_sheets)
    existing_sheets <- c(existing_sheets, sheet_name)

    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df_sub)

    addStyle(wb, sheet_name, header_style,
             rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE)

    if (nrow(df_sub) > 0) {
      addStyle(wb, sheet_name, body_style,
               rows = 2:(nrow(df_sub) + 1),
               cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE)
    }

    setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), widths = "auto")
  }
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "Transcription Factor Analysis/ED vs 6M/Summaries/All_APNS_TFs_ED_vs_6M.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

### Summary 
```{r}
TFs <- TF_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  mutate(`P Value` = as.numeric(`P Value`)) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(
    min_p = min(`P Value`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(min_p) %>%
  pull(TF)

apns_string <- function(apns) {
  if (length(apns) == 0) return("")
  paste0(apns, collapse = "; ")
}

table_TF_apns_summary <- TF_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  mutate(across(c(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, `P Value`, `FDR`, `T Stat`,
                  `Avg ED`, `Avg 6M`, `SE of Δ`), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(is_sig = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.01) %>%
  group_by(TF, `Recovery Group`) %>%
  summarise(
    `APNS Avg Δ (6M − ED)` = mean(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS SE` = sd(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`))),
    `APNS Avg P Value` = mean(`P Value`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg FDR` = mean(`FDR`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg T Stat` = mean(`T Stat`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg ED` = mean(`Avg ED`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg 6M` = mean(`Avg 6M`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `APNS Avg SE of Δ` = mean(`SE of Δ`, na.rm = TRUE),

    `Count of Significant APNS Tests` = sum(is_sig, na.rm = TRUE),

    `Significant APNS (ED vs 6M T-tests, FDR < 0.01)` = {
      apns_sig <- APNS[is_sig]
      apns_string(apns_sig)},
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(TF = factor(TF, levels = TFs)) %>%
  arrange(TF) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x)))


# export  ----------------------------------------------

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "APNS Summary")

writeData(
  wb,
  sheet = "APNS Summary",
  x = table_TF_apns_summary,
  withFilter = FALSE
)

# styling

body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")

addStyle(wb, "APNS Summary", header_style,
         rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(table_TF_apns_summary), gridExpand = TRUE)

addStyle(wb, "APNS Summary", body_style,
         rows = 2:(nrow(table_TF_apns_summary) + 1),
         cols = 1:ncol(table_TF_apns_summary), gridExpand = TRUE)

setColWidths(wb, "APNS Summary", cols = 1:ncol(table_TF_apns_summary), widths = "auto")

# Create the table of all_DEA_results genes and order APNS and Class
TF_sig_counts <- TF_within_class_EDvsM6$ttest_results %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.01) %>%
  group_by(APNS, Direction, Class) %>%
  summarise(n_TFs = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
```

### Heatmap 
```{r}
# identify TFs significant across all 10 APNS in the recovered group
tf_keep <- TF_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  filter(`Recovery Group` == "Recovered") %>%
  mutate(
    delta = as.numeric(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`),
    FDR = as.numeric(FDR)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(FDR) & FDR <= 0.01) %>%
  distinct(APNS, TF) %>%
  count(TF, name = "n_APNS_sig") %>%
  filter(n_APNS_sig == 10) %>%
  pull(TF)

tf_recovered <- TF_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  filter(`Recovery Group` == "Recovered") %>%
  mutate(
    delta = as.numeric(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`),
    FDR = as.numeric(FDR)) %>%
  filter(TF %in% tf_keep)

# rank only TFs significant across all 10 APNS
tf_levels <- tf_recovered %>%
  group_by(TF, `Direction Over Time`) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_APNS_FDR = mean(FDR, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_abs_delta = mean(abs(delta), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(`Direction Over Time`) %>%
  arrange(Avg_APNS_FDR, desc(Avg_abs_delta), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(`Direction Over Time`, Avg_APNS_FDR, desc(Avg_abs_delta)) %>%
  pull(TF) %>%
  unique()

TF_hm <- TF_within_class_EDvsM6_export %>%
  filter(`Recovery Group` == "Recovered", TF %in% tf_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    delta = as.numeric(`Avg Δ (6M − ED)`),
    FDR = as.numeric(FDR),
    APNS = factor(APNS, levels = rev(APNS_ordered)),
    TF = factor(TF, levels = tf_levels),
    neglogFDR = case_when(
      !is.na(FDR) & FDR > 0 & FDR <= 0.01 ~ -log10(FDR),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    neglogFDR_cap = pmin(neglogFDR, 10)) %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = rev(APNS_ordered), labels = rev(APNS_labels)))

tf_order <- TF_hm %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(mean_change = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_change) %>%
  pull(TF)

range(TF_hm$delta)

TF_heatmap <- ggplot(TF_hm, aes(x = TF, y = APNS)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, fill = "white", color = "grey70", stroke = 0.25) +
  
  geom_point(aes(size = neglogFDR_cap, fill = delta),
             shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) +

  scale_size_area(max_size = 5, limits = c(2, 10), guide = "none") +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Δ TF activity\n(ED \u2192 6M)",
    low = "#0067A3", mid = "white", high = "#00A9A5",
    limits = c(-0.83, 0.6),
    breaks = c(-0.4, 0, 0.4),
    na.value = "white") +
 
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top",
                               title.hjust = 0.5,
                               barheight = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                               barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),
                               title.theme = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(b = 8)))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_line(size = 0.5),

    axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 6, color = "black", margin = margin(b = 0)),
    axis.ticks.x.top = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),

    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7), 
    
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.75)) +

  scale_x_discrete(limits = tf_order, position = "top", expand = expansion(mult = c(.02, .02))) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(.07, .07)))


ggsave(filename = "Transcription Factor Analysis/ED vs 6M/Plots/TF Heatmap.jpg",
       plot = TF_heatmap, width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 600)
```
